entries.name: BBC TAL
entries.description: An open source library for building applications for Smart TV developed by BBC engineers.

entries.name: PureQML TV
entries.description: A declarative front-end framework for web-based SmartTV/STB platforms. Has experimental support of Android TV.

entries.name: ZombieBox
entries.description: An open source Smart TV framework. Strongly typed JavaScript, component based, built-in D-PAD navigation management, abstract video API with DRM for all platforms. Supports many platforms like Tizen, webOS, Android TV, etc.

entries.name: DLNA
entries.description: Industry-wide standard for sharing data over a home network. Depending on the DLNA-compatible devices you own, you might be able to stream films from your laptop to your TV, play an MP3 stored on your phone over your hi-fi system, or print a photo from your tablet on your home printer.

entries.name: DIAL
entries.description: Developed by Netflix and Google, this protocol alows client devices (like smartphone, tablet, or computer) to discover apps on server devices (like a smart TV or streaming box) and launch content on them.

entries.name: Wi-Fi Direct
entries.description: Standard enabling devices to easily connect with each other without requiring a wireless access point.

entries.name: Miracast
entries.description: Standard for wireless connections from devices (such as laptops, tablets, or smartphones) to displays (such as TVs, monitors or projectors). Works over Wi-Fi Direct.

entries.name: smartest-tv
entries.description: CLI and MCP server for playing Netflix, YouTube, and Spotify on any smart TV by name. Deep links content across LG, Samsung, Android TV, and Roku — say "Frieren S2E8" and it plays (Python).

entries.name: Fluxcast
entries.description: A user-friendly Python utility for mirroring Linux desktops to Smart TVs via Miracast and DLNA, supporting GNOME, KDE, and wlroots/Wayland.

entries.name: lrud
entries.description: Left, Right, Up, Down. A spatial navigation library for devices with input via directional controls.

entries.name: js-spatial-navigation
entries.description: A javascript-based implementation of Spatial Navigation.

entries.name: react-js-spatial-navigation
entries.description: A wrapper of js-spatial-navigation to react components.

entries.name: react-key-navigation
entries.description: Spatial Navigation components for React. Similar to the "Focus Management" of the BBC TAL.

entries.name: react-spatial-navigation
entries.description: HOC-based Spatial Navigation (key navigation) solution for React.
